name: Nishibiwajima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishibiwajima town emblem in green: a stylised letter C-shaped device with horizontal bars at the fly.
history: Flag of the former town of Nishibiwajima in Aichi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-07-07. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1969.

features.role: Nishibiwajima town emblem — a stylised letter C-shaped device with horizontal bars at the fly
